A '''Wise Woman''' is a woman who practices healing, and deals in herbs and cures. They can be found mainly in [[Tear]], [[Ebou Dar]], and in smaller communities surrounding those two cities.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wise Woman|WW}}  Some of them can channel and are considered [[Wilder]]s by the [[Aes Sedai]].

Residents of [[Ebou Dar]] who are Wise Women wear a distinguishing red belt to identify their vocation.{{ref||WW}} Most are, in fact, members of [[the Kin]] who [[Heal]] using the [[One Power]].
